changes.what: Removed the hitscan fire path (WEAPON/applySpread/traceShot). Bots now hold one tool from TOOLS, lead their target with ballisticAim+leadTarget, track target velocity frame-to-frame, apply aimError to the predicted position, fire at tool.rate and only within toolRange().
changes.why: Bots dealt instant, invisible, headshot-capable damage from 130m while players threw slow visible arcs. It made the core 'see it coming and dodge' promise false whenever a bot was in the match, and bot fill is the default.

changes.what: Added _botShoot() spawning through the same Projectiles pool as _shoot(); exposed it to brains as ctx.spawnShot; _onProjectileHit() now reports hits for projectiles owned by our simulated bots; swapped applySpread for scatter.
changes.why: Bots must use the player's exact spawn path so their shots are real dodgeable objects, and the host still needs to report their hits with the same authority as before.

changes.what: New module: scatter() (the old applySpread, reframed as launch-time projectile scatter), plus pure ballisticAim() and leadTarget() helpers.
changes.why: Keeps the one piece of useful maths from the carbine module and gives bots testable, non-random aiming.

changes.what: Deleted. WEAPON, Magazine, buildViewModel, applySpread and all spread*/headMult constants removed from the codebase.
changes.why: Dead code that still defined this game's combat constants is how a design pivot quietly rots back into the old game.

changes.what: New node test for the pure aim maths: 8 assertions on ballisticAim, leadTarget and scatter.
changes.why: The bot aim solver is pure and headless-testable, so it should not require launching a browser to verify.
